subject: general
question: What was India's ranking in the Paralympic 2020 medal tally?
solution:
The correct answer is __**24.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tokyo Paralympics**** 2020**: India finishes 24th with record 19 medals.
 
• India finished their campaign at the Tokyo Paralympics 2020 with an all-time high of 19 medals which includes five gold, eight silver, and six bronze.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• This is the best medal tally for India a single edition of the Paralympic Games.
 
• The** Paralympic Games or Paralympics, also known as the Games of the Paralympiad**, is a periodic series of international multi-sport events involving athletes with a range of physical disabilities
